question:
An electromagnetic wave propagates in vacuum with fields
$\vec E=E_0\cos(kz-\omega t)\,\hat i$ and $\vec B=B_0\cos(kz-\omega t)\,\hat j$. An electron is released from rest at the origin at $t=0$.

Which statement correctly describes the instantaneous forces on the electron at $t=0$?

options.A: The electric force is maximum and the magnetic force is zero.
options.B: Both electric and magnetic forces are maximum.
options.C: The electric force is zero and the magnetic force is maximum.
options.D: The ratio of electric to magnetic force is $c$ at $t=0$.
